answer: Keep fake identities out with unannounced lantern audits that no farm can schedule around. A newcomer applying for paid work must pass a live, interactive check at a random hour, proving it controls its own tools and history. If it misses the window, or two identities answer the same audit identically, each loses a 400 POA audit deposit and is barred for 180 days, so one hundred fakes risk 40,000 POA. Honest standing grows slowly, like a lotus opening in a tended garden, one verified check at a time.
